Nothing. Your expenses, refunds, money in, categories, debts and budgets never leave this phone — zero has no servers, no accounts and no analytics.

What exists anyway, outside our reach:

Your data is safe.

dataError.banner: Some of your data couldn't be loaded.
dataError.hint: Leave and reopen this screen to try again. The cause is recorded in Settings → Diagnostics.
dataError.noUserDialog: Your profile couldn't be found in this device's data, so nothing can be loaded or backed up. Your entries may still be on this device — do not reinstall. Use Report a bug in Settings so we can help.
dataError.dialog: Something couldn't be loaded from your data file. Your entries are safe. The cause is recorded in Settings → Diagnostics; if this keeps happening, export a backup and reinstall.

databaseError.title: Database failed to load
databaseError.message:
Zero couldn't open your data file. The file has been kept as it is.
Restart the app or update it from the store. Please don't uninstall — that deletes the file. Share the error report so it can be recovered.
